gametext: Plains. Each time a minion is played, the Free Peoples player discards a card from hand.

title: Trollshaw Forest
gametext: Forest. Each time you play a possession or artifact on your companion, draw a card.

title: Weatherhills
gametext: Each Nazgûl's twilight cost is -1.

title: Weathertop
gametext: Each Nazgûl at Weathertop is fierce.

title: Council Courtyard
gametext: Sanctuary. When the fellowship moves from Council Courtyard, remove (2).

title: Ford of Bruinen
gametext: River. Sanctuary. The twilight cost of the first Nazgûl played to Ford of Bruinen each turn is -5.

title: Frodo's Bedroom
gametext: Sanctuary. Fellowship: Play a Hobbit to draw a card.

title: Rivendell Terrace
gametext: Sanctuary. Fellowship: Play a Man to draw a card.

title: Rivendell Valley
gametext: Sanctuary. Fellowship: Play an Elf to draw a card.

title: Rivendell Waterfall
gametext: Forest. Sanctuary. While you can spot a ranger at Rivendell Waterfall, the move limit is +1 for this turn.

title: Balin's Tomb
gametext: Underground. Maneuver: Discard your tale from play or from hand to heal your companion.

title: Dwarrowdelf Chamber
gametext: Underground. When the fellowship moves to Dwarrowdelf Chamber, Gimli or 2 other companions must exert.

title: Mithril Mine
gametext: Underground. Shadow: Remove (1) to play a Shadow weapon from your discard pile.

title: Moria Lake
gametext: Marsh. When the fellowship moves to Moria Lake, Frodo or 2 other companions must exert.

title: Moria Stairway
gametext: Underground. Each companion and minion bearing a hand weapon is damage +1.

title: Pass of Caradhras
gametext: Mountain. Shadow: Spot an [isengard] minion to play a weather card from your draw deck (limit 1 per turn).

title: The Bridge of Khazad-dûm
gametext: Underground. Shadow: Play The Balrog from your draw deck or hand; The Balrog's twilight cost is -6.

texts: Play The Balrog from your draw deck

title: Dimrill Dale
gametext: Sanctuary. The twilight cost of the first [moria] Orc played each Shadow phase is -2.

title: Galadriel's Glade
gametext: Sanctuary. Fellowship: Exert an Elf to look at an opponent's hand.

title: Lothlórien Woods
gametext: Forest. Sanctuary. Each ally whose home is site 6 is strength +3.

title: Anduin Confluence
gametext: River. When the fellowship moves to Anduin Confluence, discard every ally.

title: Anduin Wilderland
gametext: Forest. River. While the fellowship is at Anduin Wilderland, skip the archery phase.

title: Silverlode Banks
gametext: River. When the fellowship moves to Silverlode Banks without a ranger, every companion must exert.

title: Anduin Banks
gametext: River. For each companion in the fellowship over 4, add 2 to the minion archery total.

title: Brown Lands
gametext: River. For each minion archer at Brown Lands, the minion archery total is +1 (limit +4).

title: Pillars of the Kings
gametext: River. Fellowship: Discard a [gondor] card from hand to heal a [gondor] companion.

title: Shores of Nen Hithoel
gametext: River. Shadow: Spot 5 Orc minions to prevent the fellowship from moving again this turn.

title: Emyn Muil
gametext: Maneuver: Exert your minion to make that minion fierce until the regroup phase.

title: Slopes of Amon Hen
gametext: The twilight cost of each [isengard] minion is -1.

title: Summit of Amon Hen
gametext: When the fellowship moves to Summit of Amon Hen, each Shadow player may draw a card for each burden.

title: Tol Brandir
gametext: River. Shadow: Play up to 3 trackers from your discard pile; end your Shadow phase.

title: Gandalf
gametext: Fellowship: Exert Gandalf to play a companion who has the Gandalf signet. The twilight cost of that companion is -2.
lore: ...his long white hair, his sweeping silver beard, and his broad shoulders, made him look like some wise king of ancient legend.
subtitle: The Grey Wizard

title: Aragorn
gametext:
Ranger.
At the start of each of your turns, you may heal another companion who has the Aragorn signet.
lore: 'He turned from that path a long time ago. He has chosen exile....'
subtitle: King in Exile
